# graphiant_group (Data Source)

Looks up a single Graphiant IAM group by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graphiant_group" "network_admins" {
  id = "grp-abc123"
}

output "network_admins_permissions" {
  value = data.graphiant_group.network_admins.permissions
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Group identifier.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Group description.
- `enterprise_ids` (List of Number)
- `group_type` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `permissions` (Attributes) Per-area role permissions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))
- `time_window_end` (Number)
- `time_window_start` (Number)
